items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: So George played every job Rene played... So I put up a band... I think George played with them yet.

ctx.x: So George played every job Rene played. His wife would only have $6 for Rene, $1 for the leader, $5 for the men. That's where when he got $6 we got $5. His wife would sign the contract and Rene didn't get none of that money. So when he played he had to owe George Lewis $2. He owed the time one player $2. That's where Morris French put the band. He owed him a long time. His brother owed $2-$3. He owed a dollar. Son Thomas. Always in trouble but he couldn't owe me nothing because I had too many children.
